<!-- title: Figures that read like figures -->
**Population was a faded footnote on the desktop.** On the phone it is one of
three large figures — share, people, population — and it looked so different
that it was taken for a phone-only statistic. The same data was on the desktop
all along, in small grey type under the meter: "Country population ≈ 36.6
million."

The desktop card now shows the three figures too, in its own typography: the
`.stats` pattern from the masthead — serif numerals with a small uppercase
label beneath. They stay on one row; when they wrapped, the third figure
dropped alone onto a second line and the block fell apart. On a region card the
label reads "region population".

On the phone, the **Export heading was not translated**: only the first four of
the six menu headings followed the interface language, so in English the Turkish
"DIŞA AKTAR" sat under LAYER / COLOUR BY / DETAIL LEVEL / THEME.
